asks: When a RecurringTask with endedByArchiving true is moved out of the Project whose archiveProject ended it, and that Project is later unarchived, what should happen to the moved RecurringTask?
because: archiveProject "ends every RecurringTask it holds that is not already ended, setting ended to true and endedByArchiving to true, so unarchiveProject can later tell it apart from a RecurringTask ended directly via endRecurrence." unarchiveProject resumes "every RecurringTask in the Project whose endedByArchiving is true." moveTask "Reassigns a Task from its current Project to a different Project" and says nothing about recurrence state. If R is ended by archiving Project A, then moved to Project B via moveTask, unarchiving A no longer finds R "in the Project", so R stays ended forever, still carrying endedByArchiving true even though the archiving that set it has since been reversed.

options.label: moveTask clears endedByArchiving
options.detail: When a RecurringTask is moved, if endedByArchiving is true it is set false, and ended stays true, unchanged. R ends up ended-directly rather than ended-by-archiving, so unarchiving A has nothing to say about it and never will.

options.label: unarchiveProject is widened to reach Tasks that were moved out
options.detail: unarchiveProject would need to resume RecurringTasks that archiveProject on this Project ended, wherever they now live, not only ones currently in the Project. Requires recording which archiveProject action ended a given RecurringTask, and raises what happens if the destination Project is itself later archived.

options.label: moveTask refuses to move a Task whose endedByArchiving is true
options.detail: A RecurringTask ended by archiving cannot be reassigned to another Project until its Project is unarchived, which resumes it, or its recurrence is ended directly. A new failure case for moveTask not in the current spec.
